content:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: P1 alert fired for rushlane-prod - reserved capacity backpressure (tenant: rushlane). Symptoms: increased tail latency, request throttling, queued bursts growing >90%. AlertID: PD-87431.

pagerduty: Incident triggered: PD-87431. Auto-escalation in 8m if not acked.

Avery (on-call): ack - taking. seeing the same dashboards. tail p99 on /v1/generate up to 2.3s, errors ~0.5% but soft-throttle metrics spiking.

Maya (sre): on it with Avery. quick check: reserved-pool rushlane-reserved shows GPU util 98%, io_wait high on worker-3. kv-cache evictions increasing.

Liam (runtime): posting logs from runtime -> suspecting KV cache cold misses + disk-backed swap causing io bottleneck. snippet:```
2026-03-14T07:02:10Z worker-3 kernel: blkio wait 120ms
2026-03-14T07:02:12Z runtime[pid=4123]: kvcache_eviction_count=472
```

Avery (on-call): steps: 1) try enabling burst-bucket to allowed for 5m to clear queue 2) scale reserved slot +1 if autoscale not kicking 3) fallback routing to cheaper model variant for rushlane-prod if latency still bad. I'll run 1 and 2 now.

Avery (on-call): /run ops scale-reserved --tenant rushlane --delta 1 --reason "temp mitigation"

deploy-bot: Scale job started: job-id 78f3. Expected spin-up ~2m.

Maya (sre): while that spins up, checking autoscale logs: controller reports throttle due to burst_limit reached at 07:01:56Z. autoscaler did not spawn new instances because quota_lock held by worker-3. investigating lock.

Liam (runtime): pushed a small change to reduce memory pressure: runtime config toggle kv_cache.eviction_threshold += 10% for rushlane pool. command:```
POST /admin/runtime/config
{"pool":"rushlane-reserved","kv_cache.eviction_threshold": "+10%"}
```

Sam (support): pinging RushLane CS + account team to notify about P1. will draft message: "We are seeing latency for your RushLane account; we're actively mitigating and will update in 15m."

Avery (on-call): PD ack noted. deploy-bot shows new instance healthy at 07:04:30Z. latency p99 dropping to 1.1s. queue length halved.

Maya (sre): confirmed io_wait reduced, worker-3 no longer the hot path. kvcache evictions trending down. I'm still seeing occasional soft-throttle events, but overall throughput recovered by ~60%.

Avery (on-call): routing rule applied: rushlane-prod -> model-compact fallback active for non-critical traffic. command run:```
PATCH /routing/policies/rushlane-prod
{"fallback_model":"m-compact-v2","fallback_fraction":0.35}
```

Rina (sre-lead): good work. would like a short RCA draft once stable. please capture: root cause hypothesis (kv-cache pressure + disk io on worker-3), why autoscaler didn't spawn (quota_lock), and mitigation steps (scale + config toggle + fallback routing). Also note customer communication.

Maya (sre): quick postmortem notes saved to /incidents/PD-87431/notes.md and linked metrics snapshots to the incident view.

Avery (on-call): handoff note: current state = degraded -> recovering. p99 ~1.05s, errors 0.12%, burst queue normal. Leaving on-call in 22m; handing off to Rina for overnight. Rina, pls ack when you see this.

Rina (sre-lead): acked. I'll take remaining monitoring windows and follow up with a root-cause doc and ops playbook updates for kv-cache pressure. If we see reoccurrence, escalate to infra eng to investigate disk-backed swap policy for that pool.

Sam (support): sent customer update at 07:12Z: "We mitigated elevated latency via temporary capacity increase and routing; we'll follow up with a full incident report." CC: account team.

pagerduty: PD-87431 marked acknowledged by Avery. Escalation timer stopped.

Avery (on-call): adding runbook note: if kvcache_eviction_count > 250 in 5m AND io_wait > 80ms -> immediate scale-reserved + reduce eviction_threshold + open infra ticket.

Maya (sre): scheduling follow-up: create infra ticket for node replacement and disk IO tuning, assigning to @Liam.

Liam (runtime): got it, will own infra ticket. prelim plan: check node dmesg, inspect nvme SMART, consider live migrate off worker-3 and reprovision with tuned kernel parameters and io scheduler.

Avery (on-call): closing Slack thread for now — will update incident doc when final RCA done. leaving log snippet of timeline in the incident doc.

incident-bot: Incident PD-87431 status: acknowledged -> mitigation in progress -> monitoring. If status changes to triggered or escalated, it will post updates here.

(End of thread)
